Digits

Watch one digit at a time, then enter the digits in order. Start with four digits. A correct answer adds one digit; a mistake removes one. Three mistakes end the run.

Time varies with your answers. Allow at least five minutes. A rare long run can take more than 20 minutes, plus any time you spend before Next.

Original forms rotate and may repeat after six starts or local data deletion.

Your actual assessment invitation controls what to prepare. This is an independent practice exercise.

This shows recall of these Assessment Practice digit sequences in this browser. It is not an intelligence, memory-capacity, employer, or hiring score. Visual and auditory runs and timing accommodations are different experiences; their results are not calibrated equivalents.
